//database: Enterprise edition databases are created with the unparenthesized id
`default` (the console and gcloud both name it that); firebase-tools
would otherwise assume `(default)`, fail the existence check and try —
and fail — to create a second database. `edition` only matters if this
config ever has to create the database itself.

//hosting: Only needed for email-link sign-in and in-app password reset. Firebase
mints those action links on a Hosting domain — Dynamic Links shut down in
August 2025, so a Hosting domain plus Universal Links / App Links is the
supported way to get the link back into the app. Run
`firebase deploy --only hosting` and see the README's 'Email links' section.
